ingredients.name: Parsley or Chives
ingredients.originalText: 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley or Chives, chopped

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 4 Slices Bacon; 2 Onions, sliced; 1 tsp Savoury; 6 Potatoes, peeled and cubed; 3 Carrots, sliced; 1 1/2 lbs Cod Fillets; 1 can Evaporated Milk; 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley or Chives, chopped. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Onions: sliced; Potatoes: peeled and cubed; Carrots: sliced; Parsley or Chives: Fresh; chopped. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
In a large, heavy saucepan, cook bacon over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes or until crisp.
Drain off all but 1 tbsp. fat from saucepan.
Cook, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until softened.
Add potatoes, carrots, water and salt.
Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
Add to vegetables and simmer for about 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
Add milk and white pepper, heat through.

Before serving, check uncooked fish or shrimp with a food thermometer: it must reach 145°F (63°C). Fish should separate easily into flakes; shrimp should be opaque and firm. Continue cooking and recheck if needed.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. In a large, heavy saucepan, cook bacon over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes or until crisp. Chop coarsely and set aside.
2. Drain off all but 1 tbsp. fat from saucepan. Add onions and savoury. Cook, stirring occasionally for 5 minutes or until softened.
3. Add potatoes, carrots, water and salt. Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until tender
4. Cut cod into 1-inch chunks. Add to vegetables and simmer for about 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily
5. Add milk and white pepper, heat through. Garnish with bacon and parsley.
